resources.string: Your conversations, remembered. Your promises, kept.
Zuri understands the messages you choose to share with it, remembers what matters, and helps you run your personal life and your business, privately on this phone.
Get started
I already use Zuri on the web
Private by design
Here is exactly how Zuri treats what it sees.
Understood on this phone
Zuri keeps what it learns in an encrypted database on this phone.
You choose every source
Zuri ignores every app until you switch it on, and you can exclude any chat or person.
Nothing leaves without asking
Cloud AI, sync and uploads are separate switches, all off until you turn them on.
Every insight shows its source
Tap anything Zuri remembers to see where it came from, then correct or delete it.
Zuri can only see what other apps show in notifications. It can’t read old chats or open apps on your behalf.
